---
title: "compile into csv"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
files <- list.files(path = ".", pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

for (f in files) {
  data <- readRDS(f)
 
  # only take the clean table
  if (!is.null(data$table)) {
    out_name <- sub("\\.rds$", ".csv", basename(f))
   
    write.csv(data$table, out_name, row.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    message("Skipped: ", f, " (no table found)")
  }
}
```


```{r}
situation1_48 <- bind_rows(mget(paste0("result_s", 1:48)))
```
